headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.45
summary: Xbox Friends connects again using the current Xbox Live services, and your friend list now lives right on the launch screen.

items.text: Connect the friends screen using the current Xbox Live peoplehub and social services.
Show the HTTP status when an Xbox Live request fails so problems are diagnosable.
See your Xbox friends and their online status directly on the launch screen.
Tap a friend on the dashboard to open the full friends screen.
